Process Engineering & Scale-Up Support

Process engineering and scale-up support bridge the transition from development to commercial manufacturing. Engineering activities focus on ensuring processes are robust, reproducible, and suitable for larger-scale production under GMP conditions.

Scale-up introduces new technical and operational challenges, including equipment selection, process optimization, and integration with facility systems. Early engineering involvement helps identify risks and supports smoother technology transfer.

Effective process engineering supports consistent product quality and operational efficiency as production volumes increase.

Process engineering and scale-up activities often include:

Process design and optimization

Equipment selection and configuration

Scale-up risk assessment

Integration with manufacturing systems

Support for process validation activities
